package main
import (
    "fmt"
    "math"
)
func main() {
    var a, b, c float64
    fmt.Scan(&a)
    fmt.Scan(&b)
    fmt.Scan(&c)

    p := (a+b+c)/2
    A := math.Sqrt(p*(p-a)*(p-b)*(p-c))

    fmt.Printf("%.2f\n", A)
}
